name: zfmv_action_play_avi_constructor
description: zFMV_ActionPlayAvi::Constructor initializes the AVI action, builds the media path, records mode flags, and resolves missing files through the CD-drive fallback.
known_limits: Tier S current: zfmv_action_constructors VC5SP3 compare passes for 0x463570 with zero unmasked byte mismatches after 40 relocation-masked bytes and 5 trimmed VC NOP bytes.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x463570 validates the MSVC thiscall constructor shape: install the action-PlayAvi vtable, clear next, compute root and file name lengths, allocate rootLen + fileLen + 27 bytes through calloc, format the joined path as root\file, store modeFlags, call _stat on the joined path, and when the file is missing call zSys::FindFileOnDriveType with DRIVE_CDROM and copy a non-null returned path into the existing buffer before returning self.

The dependency frontier has no visible source blockers; zSys::FindFileOnDriveType is accepted functional, C runtime allocation/format/stat calls are provider boundaries, and compiler EH glue is provider-boundary.

The native smokes verify returned self, action-PlayAvi vtable identity, next clearing, mediaPath allocation/content, modeFlags storage, the existing-file no-fallback path, and the missing-file DRIVE_CDROM fallback path.
